nodes.name: Build CASE002 Conversation Context
nodes.notes: Reads Receive-owned conversation state and builds bounded context for the stateless semantic interpreter. No side effects.

nodes.name: Run CASE002 Gemini Interpreter
nodes.notes: Stateless semantic interpretation. Any model/subworkflow error must fall back to deterministic policy rather than fail the WhatsApp intake.

nodes.name: Conversation Appointment State
nodes.notes: LEVEL-2 PoC. Gemini interprets language; deterministic state/policy owns scheduling, routing and side effects. It emits a response plan plus deterministic fallback for a separate language renderer.

nodes.name: Render CASE002 Conversation Reply
nodes.notes: Stateless language rendering only. On any error, deterministic validator sends fallbackText.

nodes.name: Verify CASE002 Rendered Reply
nodes.notes: Deterministic guardrail. Rejects renderer output that drops protected facts, introduces unknown dates/times/plates/prices, or exposes internal terminology.

nodes.name: Send Appointment Agent Reply
nodes.notes: Uses hardened KAPSO_MESSAGE_SEND@1.0. Fail closed on provider error.
